verdict.rationale: Netlify documents an official command-line tool, netlify-cli, for deploying sites, running local dev servers and managing projects from the terminal, and a probe confirms the CLI docs exist. The `netlify deploy --allow-anonymous` flow suits agent-driven, login-free deploys. Community users report using Netlify Dev, though one hit an underdocumented netlify.toml [dev] config error. missing for 10: explicit AI/agent-oriented CLI features (e.g., machine-readable output, non-interactive mode docs), clearer independent hands-on corroboration of the CLI working smoothly.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Deploy sites, run local dev servers, and manage your Netlify projects right from the terminal with this powerful command-line tool.
